mapper.select: select q.id, q.stem, q.type, q.difficulty, q.view_count as viewCount, q.correct_count as correctCount, s.name as subjectName, k.name as knowledgePointName from question q left join subject s on s.id = q.subject_id left join knowledge_point k on k.id = q.knowledge_point_id where q.deleted = 0 and q.status = 1 and q.subject_id = #{subjectId} order by q.view_count desc, q.id desc limit #{limit}

select q.knowledge_point_id as knowledgePointId, k.name as knowledgePointName, count(*) as total from question q left join knowledge_point k on k.id = q.knowledge_point_id where q.deleted = 0 and q.subject_id = #{subjectId} group by q.knowledge_point_id, k.name
